$comment: Names production HAS that the frozen capture (lib/capability/snapshots/current.ts) does not record, each OBSERVED in production's own catalog after the capture was taken. Read ONLY by test/helpers/schemaColumnScan.ts (productionSchema), which grades against the capture PLUS these. This is NOT a capture and must not grow into one: a capture is every table, column and function, digest-verified by production; an observation is the handful of names a read-only catalog query found present, with the query, the date and the evidence. SHRINK-ONLY: schemaColumnProductionScan.test.ts fails when a capture that current.ts names already holds an observed name (delete the observation at that refresh), and when an observed name is not declared by the migration it is attributed to. When production is re-captured, this file empties. RETIRED 2026-10-24: the one observation (2026-10-17, 2998's stories.deleted_at, story_purge_queue and job_health.last_success_at) was deleted at the capability refresh, because snapshots/20261024-production-schema.json records all three names itself. The list is empty, not gone: the next name production holds that a capture predates goes here, with its query, date and evidence.
